acceptanceCriteria: With ps unavailable, a test shows no build descendant survives the wrapper's termination (e.g. process-group kill), or the residual is documented as accepted.
The base package-existence check excludes directories owned by a nested module, with a test case; one mutation brings the miscount back.
body: Residual from the V1-1309/1310/1298 affected-tooling lane (PR #916, branch claude/affected-batch-1309-1310-1298, head c9f0f22ac, base 595359a1b). (1) script/gate-affected-corvint.sh: when ps fails the wrapper warns and kills only the `go build` process, so compiler grandchildren are not reached. (2) The AFP-V0-050 base-commit read approximates package existence as a directory outside testdata with a direct .go file; it ignores module ownership (nested go.mod), so a nested-module directory counts as a package of the main module.
title: affected tooling edge residuals: ps failure leaves build grandchildren running; base read-scope package existence ignores module ownership
